items.title: Special cancellation right due to price increase
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to cancel without notice, effective 01.01.2027 (the date the new, higher prices take effect). For the cancellation to be effective at the old price (i.e. to end the contract before the new prices apply), it must reach the supplier 'vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise' — before 01.01.2027. The last calendar day on which it can still arrive is therefore 31.12.2026. 2026-12-31 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed; this is a hard arrival deadline set by the company, not a statutory period subject to §193 BGB extension.

warnings: The letter only states that the cancellation must 'reach' the supplier before 01.01.2027 without giving a specific calendar deadline, so allow enough mailing/processing time well before 31.12.2026 rather than sending at the last moment.

The quoted IBAN (DE80 3705 0198 0005 5818 10) is a formally valid German IBAN, but this letter does not request any payment to it — it is only the supplier's standard account information printed in the letterhead.
